business_summary: Enerflex Ltd. offers modular natural gas, power technology, and treated water solutions in North America, Latin America, and the Eastern Hemisphere. The company's portfolio includes compression, processing, cryogenic, treated water solutions, and energy infrastructure portfolio includes energy infrastructure solutions under contract for natural gas processing, compression, and treated water equipment. It also provides contract operations services that includes trained personnel, equipment, tools, materials, and supplies to meet natural gas needs, electric power, and produced water needs as well as designing, sourcing, installing, operating, servicing, repairing, and maintaining equipment. In addition, the company offers after-market services products, such as delivers comprehensive mechanical services to client partners, including parts distribution; operations and maintenance solutions; equipment optimization and maintenance programs; manufacturer warranties; exchange components; long-term service agreements; and technical services, as well as provides contract operations and maintenance services for natural gas facilities. Further, the company involves in the sale of modular natural gas-handling and low-carbon solutions that are engineered, designed, fabricated, and assembled for gas processing, including cryogenic solutions; gas compression systems; CCUS; water treatment; and electric power generation systems, as well as engineers, designs, fabricates, constructs, commissions, operates, and services hydrocarbon processing equipment. Additionally, it provides field construction, installation, and commissioning for an integrated electric power solution, as well as re-engineering and refurbishment services. The company was formerly known as Enerflex Systems Income Fund and changed its name to Enerflex Ltd. in January 2010. Enerflex Ltd. was founded in 1980 and is headquartered in Calgary, Canada.
business_summary_ko: Enerflex Ltd.는 북미, 라틴 아메리카 및 동반구에서 모듈식 천연 가스, 전력 기술 및 처리수 솔루션을 제공합니다. 회사의 포트폴리오에는 압축, 처리, 극저온, 처리수 솔루션이 포함되며, 에너지 인프라 포트폴리오에는 천연가스 처리, 압축 및 처리수 장비용으로 계약된 에너지 인프라 솔루션이 포함됩니다. 또한 천연가스 수요, 전력, 생산수 수요를 충족할 뿐만 아니라 장비 설계, 소싱, 설치, 운영, 서비스, 수리 및 유지관리를 위한 훈련된 인력, 장비, 도구, 자재 및 공급품을 포함하는 계약 운영 서비스도 제공합니다. 또한 회사는 부품 유통을 포함하여 고객 파트너에게 포괄적인 기계 서비스를 제공하는 등 애프터마켓 서비스 제품을 제공합니다. 운영 및 유지 관리 솔루션; 장비 최적화 및 유지 관리 프로그램; 제조업체 보증; 부품 교환; 장기 서비스 계약; 및 기술 서비스를 제공할 뿐만 아니라 천연가스 시설에 대한 계약 운영 및 유지 관리 서비스도 제공합니다. 또한, 회사는 모듈식 natu 판매에도 참여하고 있습니다.
